name: Pain Is Pleasure
text:
**Pain Is Pleasure** (religion trait; Zon-Kuthon)

You have discovered a hint of the dark truths that lay hidden within blood and flesh. You gain a +1 trait bonus on Fortitude and Will saves whenever you have fewer than half your maximum number of hit points.
